name: @newboot-io/superset-module-sdk
description: Write a module for a Newboot Superset: fetch its module twin, read its secrets, send and receive telemetry.
author: Newboot <dev@newboot.io>

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: rm -rf build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='build-test/src/**' --test-coverage-lines=90 build-test/test/*.test.js
